title: Pope's father's excursions by train
summary: His father's band took train excursions for dancing; Pope does not know where his father learned music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I wondered, did your father ever, I don't like to keep bothering you about your father because naturally you don't know everything.
Well, back in his days, they made trips in Yard River to South of Bay. They did? Yes, they made trips on them. They went on excursions, yes, and played dancing over there.
Would that be on the train or the folk? On the train, on the train.
On the train, on the train.
Training excursions. Yes, that's right. Did your father ever talk about where he learned music, if he picked it up himself, or if he had a teacher, or what he did?
I don't remember. I don't remember.
